value.name: Sonoma Clean Power
value.notes: Sonoma Clean Power is the public power provider for Sonoma and Mendocino counties, serving all incorporated cities in Sonoma County except Healdsburg (its own municipal utility) and Ukiah (Mendocino County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: It is the permit holder's responsibility to request inspections from the Building Division as the project progresses
Inspections are performed Monday through Thursday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
Schedule via SelecTXT: text 'SCHEDULE' (or the express command format) to 877-813-1904 with the permit number, inspection code, and date/AM-PM, or call Building at 707-522-8346
inspection_steps.notes: This is the Town's general Building Inspections process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the Town's page does not describe a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.notes: Applications not submitted via Symbium are subject to plan review ranging from 1-3 business days; Symbium submissions receive instantaneous code-compliance review.

other_conditions: Solar collection systems may be added to roofs or sides of existing structures, provided they comply with applicable height limits
All contractors performing work in the Town of Windsor must hold an active business license prior to permit issuance
